// Diagnostic only: do not change test timers, assertions, or application behavior.
import { afterAll, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { PerformanceObserver, performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { setInterval as interval, clearInterval as clear } from 'node:timers';
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const output = 'tests/fixtures/foundation-release-check-20261011/timing.jsonl';
const now = () => Number(process.hrtime.bigint()) / 1e6;
let last = now(), started = last, name = '', cpu = process.cpuUsage();
const record = (event: object) => appendFileSync(output, JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,...event})+'\n');
const timer = interval(() => {
  const current = now(), elapsed = current-last;
  if(elapsed > 500) record({kind:'worker-timer-gap',test:name,elapsedMs:elapsed,cpuUs:process.cpuUsage(cpu),memory:process.memoryUsage()});
  last=current;cpu=process.cpuUsage();
},100);
timer.unref();
const gc = new PerformanceObserver(list => {
  for(const entry of list.getEntries()) if(entry.duration > 100) record({kind:'gc',test:name,durationMs:entry.duration});
});
gc.observe({entryTypes:['gc']});
beforeEach(context => {name=context.task.name;started=now();record({kind:'start',test:name,at:performance.timeOrigin+performance.now()});});
afterEach(() => record({kind:'end',test:name,elapsedMs:now()-started}));
afterAll(() => {clear(timer);gc.disconnect();});
